FlowDefinition.description:
Screen subflow used when an asset return is processed or moved back to inventory. Move to Inventory hops through Returned (to snapshot assignment history) then Inventory (wipe lifecycle fields except First Stage Date). Retire remains a single-step status change.
2026-08-12: Move to Inventory now stamps Status=Returned and Return_Date__c first (practice account and lifecycle fields still populated), then a second DML sets Status=Inventory, moves Account to Inventory Account, clears Parent, and wipes assignment lifecycle fields except First_Stage_Date__c. Return Date lives on the Returned assignment only.
FlowDefinition.masterLabel: Asset Assignment Subflow - Screen - Process Pending Returns
